data.body:
fix-bug:investigation

VERDICT: LIVE (confirmed at SHA 6734986bd9; no changes after ticket creation 2026-06-03T00:18:34Z)

EXACT LOCATION:
- File: tests/scripts/test-migrate-closure-checks.sh
- Line 989: trap '_restore_real_classifier' EXIT ERR INT TERM  — overwrites git-fixtures.sh _cleanup trap
- Line 1001: trap - EXIT ERR INT TERM  — clears ALL EXIT/ERR/INT/TERM traps, including _cleanup

ROOT CAUSE:
bash EXIT trap semantics: each 'trap <action> EXIT' call is a full replacement of the current EXIT handler; there is no append mode. When _install_stub_classifier runs 'trap ...' (line 989), it silently overwrites the 'trap _cleanup EXIT' that git-fixtures.sh registered at its line 50 (sourced at test file line 29). When _restore_real_classifier runs 'trap - EXIT ERR INT TERM' (line 1001), it clears ALL signal handlers including the original _cleanup. Result: _CLEANUP_DIRS entries (temp fixture dirs) are never removed on process exit, leaking temp dirs.

FIX APPROACH (use the established idiom from tests/run-all.sh lines 72-79, 88-96, 107-112):
In _install_stub_classifier, before overriding the trap, save the prior EXIT trap:
  _PRIOR_EXIT_TRAP_BEFORE_CLASSIFIER=
Then set the chained trap:
  trap '_restore_real_classifier' EXIT ERR INT TERM
In _restore_real_classifier, instead of 'trap - EXIT ERR INT TERM', restore the saved trap:
  if [[ -n "$_PRIOR_EXIT_TRAP_BEFORE_CLASSIFIER" ]]; then
    trap "$_PRIOR_EXIT_TRAP_BEFORE_CLASSIFIER" EXIT
  else
    trap - EXIT
  fi
  trap - ERR INT TERM
Note: ERR/INT/TERM were only added by _install_stub_classifier, so those can safely be cleared; only EXIT needs the saved-trap restore.

RED TEST PLAN:
Run the test file in a subprocess and check that _CLEANUP_DIRS entries are removed.
Simplest approach: inject a sentinel dir into _CLEANUP_DIRS before calling _install_stub_classifier,
force EXIT (e.g., kill via abnormal return or explicit exit), then assert the sentinel dir is gone.
Alternatively: add a post-test assertion function that checks _CLEANUP_DIRS entries don't exist on disk after the test suite exits — readable from the suite runner by checking if temp dirs persist. RED state: run tests/scripts/test-migrate-closure-checks.sh, then verify the /tmp dirs created by fixture calls persist (they will before fix, gone after fix).

SIBLING FILES WITH SAME CLOBBER PATTERN (note only, do not fix here):
1. tests/scripts/test-retro-gather-suggestions.sh: sources git-fixtures at line 28, then sets three separate 'trap ... EXIT' at lines 75, 102, 128 — each overwrites the prior (including git-fixtures _cleanup). Last one (line 128) survives; _CLEANUP_DIRS entries from that file will still leak.
2. tests/scripts/test-audit-source-consumers.sh: sets 'trap ... EXIT' at line 39 BEFORE sourcing git-fixtures at line 42. git-fixtures guard (checks _CLEANUP_DIRS not set) allows its trap to overwrite the line-39 trap — so _AUDIT_EXIT_FILE won't be cleaned up on EXIT.

FEASIBILITY: yes — straightforward; the exact idiom is already established in tests/run-all.sh.
